products.name: Boult Audio Z40 Pro with 100H Playtime, Quad Mic ENC
products.description:
The Boult Audio Z40 Pro is engineered for audiophiles seeking unparalleled sound quality and long-lasting performance. These wireless earbuds feature 100 hours of playtime on a single charge, ensuring that you can enjoy uninterrupted music, calls, and gaming sessions for days. With Quad Mic ENC (Environmental Noise Cancellation) technology, the Z40 Pro delivers crystal-clear call quality by minimizing background noise, even in crowded or noisy environments. The earbuds are designed for ultimate comfort, with ergonomic and snug-fitting ear tips that keep them secure during workouts, runs, or any active lifestyle.
Whether you’re working out, commuting, or just relaxing, the Boult Audio Z40 Pro ensures an immersive listening experience with rich bass and clear treble. The IPX7 waterproof rating makes them resistant to sweat and water, making them the perfect companion for outdoor activities. The earbuds also support Bluetooth 5.0, providing a stable and fast connection, and are compatible with both iOS and Android devices.

products.name: Maybelline 128 Warm Nude Liquid Foundation
products.description:
The NARS 3-in-1 Foundation is a versatile product designed to offer a combination of foundation, concealer, and SPF protection in one easy-to-use bottle. It provides a buildable medium-to-full coverage that blurs imperfections, evens out skin tone, and helps protect the skin from harmful UV rays. The formula is infused with skincare benefits that leave the skin feeling nourished and hydrated while providing a natural matte finish that controls shine all day long.
Ideal for combination to oily skin types, the NARS 3-in-1 Foundation ensures that your complexion remains smooth and flawless with long-lasting wear. It’s lightweight, breathable, and offers a seamless application without the need for touch-ups. Whether you're going for a full-glam look or something more natural, this foundation has you covered.
